scope: Experimental Qwen frontends on the DNNKernels semantic graph; generic fusion additions; bit-identity against the previous runners. Short-context decode only.

frontend.standard_ops: standardop!: IR kinds imported graphs use (mm.default, fused.swiglu, add.Tensor, ...), graph-owned SemanticValue results, whole-tensor reshapes, registered weight objects (KQuantMatrix)
frontend.opaque_kernels: semantickernel! with per-kernel kernelresults methods; unknown kernels refuse
frontend.storage_hazards: semanticfusion validates that no pass moved a read past a write of the same caller tensor or stopped writing a bound version; offending ops are pinned and the passes rerun
frontend.pattern_stage: patternfusion (fuseswiglu, fuseswiglumm, fusegroupedrms) shared by Model and semantic graphs
frontend.q8_sharing: enabled with bound results; writes to bound storage drop representations prepared before the write
frontend.foldresidual: r + mm/swiglumm folds into the product's store; in place for one packed column, scratch otherwise

bug_fixed: genericfusion(dict) returned Dict{String,Any}; every Model build with fusion threw a MethodError since the pipeline was extracted

qwen35_prefill_chunk20_32_kl_vs_fp32.note: chunks above 16 columns now take the shared K-quant GEMM (fp16 activations) instead of Q8 GEMV passes

qwen36_radeon_tok_s.note: 6 interleaved rounds, clocks lower than earlier runs

throughput.qwen35_2b_radeon: old 80.8 vs new 80.6 tok/s, measured while another chat's job held the GPU at 99%; parity only, absolute numbers invalid
